answer.text:
Adobe’s total Digital Media segment revenue in fiscal 2024 was **$15,864 million ($15.864 billion)**, up **12%** year over year from **$14,216 million** in fiscal 2023. The calculation from the reported amounts is \((15{,}864-14{,}216) ÷ 14{,}216 × 100 \approx 11.6\%\), which rounds to **12%**.

**Source:** Adobe Inc. 10-K, accession **0000796343-25-000004**, “Segments,” chunk **839ad4e2-d434-562b-b699-c27185c0972b**.
